list_toggle: Show or hide the conversation list
machine_select: Machine that answers. Automatic: this machine if it is free, otherwise the least busy of your machines that lend this model.
peers_chip_title: Also search the libraries of your machines and your friends (your question goes to them)
web_title: Search the web when your question calls for it (confirmation before sending, or for the session)
think_title: Let the model think before answering (slower, often better)
permissions_title: What the assistant may use to answer you
edit_bar: Editing your last message: sending it replaces the rest of the conversation.
hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · Esc to stop the answer
group_auto: Models · the answering machine is picked automatically
group_cluster: Split across my machines · graphics cards combined
no_model_remote_phone: No model on this phone: your answers will be computed by your paired machines that lend theirs.
no_model_remote_pc: No model on this PC: your answers will be computed by your paired machines that lend theirs.
no_model_phone: No model on this phone to answer.
no_model_pc: No model on this PC to answer.
no_model_phone_ollama: No model on this phone to answer (or Ollama is not responding: AIODOS retries on its own every 8 seconds).
no_model_pc_ollama: No model on this PC to answer (or Ollama is not responding: AIODOS retries on its own every 8 seconds).
cluster_ready: Split model ready on your machines.
cluster_preparing: Preparing the split model while you write: {status}
answer_running: An answer is in progress: stop it (Esc) before switching conversations.
welcome_text: Your machines and those of the public network compute together. The web is only used with your consent.
regenerate: Regenerate the answer (with the chosen model)
web_off_text: Your question seems to call for a web search, which is turned off. Run it for this message? Only the query below will be sent to DuckDuckGo.
web_send_text: The query below will be sent to DuckDuckGo. No other data leaves your machine.
ask_no_more_session: Don't ask again during this session
peers_refused: Passages found on your machines and your friends' machines are not sent to a model lent by a friend: this answer will do without them.
peers_title: Also search on your friends' machines?
peers_text: Your question will go to {names}: each machine searches the libraries it opens to you, and only the passages found come back. AIODOS does not keep your question there, but each machine records in its log that you searched, and how many passages it returned to you.
ask_no_more_friends: Don't ask again for these friends during this session
attachment_sending: An attachment is still on its way: one moment…
attachment_question: What can you tell me about the attachment?
attachment_describe: Describe the image to create: the attached image will be its starting point.
no_model_install: No model available: install one (“Install a model”).
no_model_ollama: No model available: check that Ollama is running.
folder_name_empty: The folder name cannot be empty.
message_not_found: Message not found in this conversation.
attachment_missing: Attachment not found or already sent: attach it again.
changed: The conversation changed in the meantime (another window?): it is being reloaded.
public_bigger_text: A machine on the public network has a bigger model ({model}). Use it for your conversations?
public_bigger_note: This answer keeps the chosen model. Your choice applies from now on; you can change it in Settings.
public_documents_text: This answer relies on your documents. Send the useful passages to a machine on the public network?
public_documents_note: This answer did not go to a stranger. Your choice applies from now on; you can change it in Settings.
public_saved_yes: Noted: yes. You can change your mind in Settings (This machine, Sharing computing power).
public_saved_no: Noted: no. You can change your mind in Settings (This machine, Sharing computing power).
public_first_title: Your conversation goes to a stranger
public_first_text: The machine of someone on the public network reads this conversation to answer it, without knowing who is asking; nothing is kept there. What you write may still reveal who you are. To avoid it: “On my machines only” (Permissions, under the message box) for one conversation, or “Have my conversations computed by strangers” in Settings for all of them.
mine_only_help: Nothing from this conversation goes to a stranger on the public network.
mine_only_on: On my machines only: nothing from this conversation goes to a stranger
